maps.title: Zero Visibility
maps.comments: Tempo changes and bomb-heavy choreography. Review clearance around retained reset cues.

maps.title: Wake Me Up When September Ends
maps.comments: Manually adjusted acoustic guitar attacks, including early and late strums near the beat. Preserve the original timestamps. Sustained tempo drift and expressive microtiming are distinct.

maps.title: Move
maps.comments: Repeated handoff motif around beats 73–74.5 and intentional bomb-guided parity resets around beats 266–268. Useful for independent rhythm and pattern tests.

maps.title: Iris
maps.comments: Mixed 4/4 and 6/8 meter, variable tempo, low base BPM, and changing guitar, vocal, and percussion emphasis. Meticulous authored spread with arcs and chains.

maps.title: Superhuman

maps.title: Death Blossoms
maps.comments: Useful for checking whether phrase budget transfers add unmatched hits or oversimplify the rhythm.

maps.title: Rumors of My Demise Have Been Greatly Exaggerated
maps.comments: Preserve complete recurring spaced entrances before denser runs. Individual hit scores can fragment the figure.

maps.title: Gimme Love
maps.comments: Strong downbeat feel with sparse fourth-beat accents and a major tempo change. Easy wall choreography changes how the sparse sections read.

maps.title: Virtual Friends

maps.title: The Boys Are Back In Town

maps.title: Stricken

maps.title: Question!

maps.title: Ashes Of The Innocent

maps.title: Happy?

maps.title: Paper Wings
